title: aislewise
description: A live 3D digital twin of the data hall, built from data and fed by the devices already on the floor. A twin is a folder of DTDL v3 models, twin instances, a presentation file and a theme, and one generic Three.js runtime renders any of them as a single self-contained page with overview, thermal and network modes. A twin core service feeds the page over WebSocket, and an adapter kit reads BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, Redfish, Prometheus, Project Haystack and MQTT, with simulated devices for each. A CLI, a DCIM importer and an MCP server let a person or an agent build and edit a twin.
